## Paavo Sattler

**Researcher in Statistics**  
TU Dortmund University · RWTH Aachen University  
[paavo.sattler@tu-dortmund.de](mailto:paavo.sattler@tu-dortmund.de) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8731-0893) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.de/citations?user=MXSrCMkAAAAJ) · [GitHub](https://github.com/PaavoSattler)

## Research Interests

- Multivariate and high-dimensional statistical inference
- Nonparametric and resampling-based inference
- Structured, multiple, directional, and one-sided hypotheses
- Covariance and correlation structures
- Statistical computing and methodological software

## Software

- **CovCorTest** — statistical tests for covariance and correlation matrices and their structures. [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=CovCorTest)
- **hdrm** — high-dimensional repeated-measures inference. CRAN link to be added after release.
- **HypoShrink** — companion hypothesis matrices and computationally efficient hypothesis representations. [GitHub](https://github.com/PaavoSattler/HypoShrink) · [DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17214498)

## Teaching & Supervision

Selected teaching includes Mathematics of Data Science, Six Sigma Methods, Introduction to Probability Theory and Statistics, Multivariate Probability and Statistics, Reading Course in Statistical Inference, and Nonparametric Statistics.

Since 2024, co-supervision of a PhD project on semi- and nonparametric analysis of covariance. Previous supervision includes bachelor theses on high-dimensional repeated-measures software, one-sided hypotheses using quadratic forms, and shrinkage estimators for high-dimensional quadratic-form methods.
